declarations.docstring: Applying the first displayed linear map to the displayed product agrees with applying the second displayed linear map to the remaining factor.
An auxiliary element in the type indexed by an element of the quiver.
The value underlying the auxiliary element is one.
An auxiliary ring homomorphism to the field indexed by an element of the quiver.
The auxiliary ring homomorphism agrees with the displayed linear map indexed by the nil path.
The auxiliary ring homomorphism sends the displayed element associated with a quiver homomorphism to zero.
An auxiliary family of types indexed by a finite quiver.
The value underlying the displayed action is the auxiliary ring homomorphism applied to the scalar times the value underlying the element.
The displayed action agrees with scalar multiplication through the auxiliary ring homomorphism.
An auxiliary family of linear maps to the field.
The auxiliary linear map applied to the displayed binary construction is one when the displayed optional value equals its index and zero otherwise.
The auxiliary linear map applied to a finitely supported singleton is its scalar at the matching index and zero otherwise.
The displayed optional operation returns the nil path at an element of the quiver exactly when both inputs are that nil path.
The displayed optional operation on two indices returns the first index exactly when the second is the nil path at the displayed endpoint of the first.
The additive commutative group structure on the auxiliary type.
The field module structure on the auxiliary type.
The module structure on the auxiliary type over the surrounding scalar type.
The displayed scalar associated with a quiver homomorphism acts as zero on the auxiliary type.
If some pair of vertices admits an arrow, the displayed predicate does not hold for zero in the associated algebra.
